title: This, that, these, those - Demonstrative pronouns and adjectives

explanation.en: For plural nouns like 'books,' we use the plural demonstrative 'these' for things that are near.
explanation.ru: Для существительных во множественном числе, таких как 'books', мы используем указательное местоимение 'these' для предметов, которые находятся рядом.
explanation.uz: 'Books' kabi ko'plikdagi otlar uchun yaqin turgan narsalar uchun ko'plik ko'rsatuvchi 'these' so'zidan foydalanamiz.

explanation.en: For a singular noun like 'car,' we use the singular demonstrative 'that' for things that are far away.
explanation.ru: Для существительного в единственном числе, такого как 'car', мы используем указательное местоимение 'that' для предметов, которые находятся далеко.
explanation.uz: 'Car' kabi birlikdagi ot uchun uzoqdagi narsalar uchun birlik ko'rsatuvchi 'that' so'zidan foydalanamiz.

explanation.en: For a singular noun like 'house,' we use the singular demonstrative 'this' for things that are near.
explanation.ru: Для существительного в единственном числе, такого как 'house', мы используем указательное местоимение 'this' для предметов, которые находятся рядом.
explanation.uz: 'House' kabi birlikdagi ot uchun yaqin turgan narsalar uchun birlik ko'rsatuvchi 'this' so'zidan foydalanamiz.

explanation.en: For plural nouns like 'apples,' we use the plural demonstrative 'those' for things that are far away.
explanation.ru: Для существительных во множественном числе, таких как 'apples', мы используем указательное местоимение 'those' для предметов, которые находятся далеко.
explanation.uz: 'Apples' kabi ko'plikdagi otlar uchun uzoqdagi narsalar uchun ko'plik ko'rsatuvchi 'those' so'zidan foydalanamiz.

explanation.en: The noun 'shoes' is plural, so it requires the plural demonstrative 'these.'
explanation.ru: Существительное 'shoes' во множественном числе, поэтому оно требует указательное местоимение 'these'.
explanation.uz: 'Shoes' oti ko'plikda, shuning uchun u 'these' ko'rsatuvchi so'zini talab qiladi.

explanation.uz: 'Noise' oti birlikda, shuning uchun u 'that' ko'rsatuvchi so'zini va 'is' fe'lini talab qiladi.

explanation.en: The noun 'ball' is singular, so it requires a singular demonstrative like 'that.'
explanation.ru: Существительное 'ball' в единственном числе, поэтому оно требует указательное местоимение в единственном числе, такое как 'that'.
explanation.uz: 'Ball' oti birlikda, shuning uchun u 'that' kabi birlikdagi ko'rsatuvchi so'zni talab qiladi.

explanation.uz: 'Flower' oti birlikda, shuning uchun u 'this' birlik ko'rsatuvchi so'zini talab qiladi. 'Is' fe'li ham birlikdagi otga mos keladi.

explanation.ru: Указательное местоимение 'this' в единственном числе используется для обозначения существительного 'kind' в единственном числе.
explanation.uz: Birlikdagi 'this' ko'rsatuvchi so'zi birlikdagi 'kind' otiga ishora qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

explanation.en: The noun 'book' is singular, so it requires a singular demonstrative like 'this' or 'that.' Both are grammatically correct without further context.
explanation.ru: Существительное 'book' в единственном числе, поэтому оно требует указательного местоимения в единственном числе, такого как 'this' или 'that'. Оба варианта грамматически верны без дополнительного контекста.
explanation.uz: 'Book' oti birlikda, shuning uchun u 'this' yoki 'that' kabi birlikdagi ko'rsatuvchi so'zni talab qiladi. Qo'shimcha kontekstsiz ikkalasi ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

items.text: Hi, Tom! Look at ___1___ old car. ___2___ is my favorite. And ___3___ trees over there are very tall. My parents bought ___4___ house on the corner. Do you see ___5___ big red door? I also have some plants. ___6___ plants here are my favorite. ___7___ flowers in the vase are from my garden. I also have a big dog. ___8___ is my dog, its name is Max. And ___9___ cats sitting on the wall are my neighbors' cats. I love ___10___ garden a lot. ___11___ trees over there give us a lot of shade. ___12___ is the best garden in the neighborhood. Look, ___13___ house over there has a blue roof. I think ___14___ is very pretty. And what about ___15___ flowers on your table? They are beautiful.

explanation.en: The correct use of 'this/that/these/those' depends on whether the noun is singular or plural and its distance. 'This' and 'these' are for near objects, while 'that' and 'those' are for far ones. 'It' is a pronoun used for a single object. 'Those' is used with plural nouns that are far away, and 'that' is used with a singular noun that is far away.
explanation.ru: Правильное использование 'this/that/these/those' зависит от того, является ли существительное единственным или множественным числом и его расстояния. 'This' и 'these' используются для близких предметов, а 'that' и 'those' — для далеких. 'It' — это местоимение, используемое для одного предмета. 'Those' используется с существительными во множественном числе, которые находятся далеко, а 'that' — с существительным в единственном числе, которое находится далеко.
explanation.uz: 'This/that/these/those' so'zlarining to'g'ri ishlatilishi otning birlik yoki ko'plikda ekanligi va uning masofasiga bog'liq. 'This' va 'these' yaqin narsalar uchun, 'that' va 'those' esa uzoqdagi narsalar uchun ishlatiladi. 'It' bitta narsa uchun ishlatiladigan olmoshdir. 'Those' uzoqdagi ko'plik otlar bilan, 'that' esa uzoqdagi birlik otlar bilan ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

items.text: My new school is very big. ___1___ is a very modern building. ___2___ big window over there lets in a lot of light. Look at ___3___ students walking in the hallway; they are my classmates. I like ___4___ new school a lot. ___5___ teachers are also very friendly. ___6___ is my friend, Maria. She is talking to ___7___ boy with the red backpack. ___8___ is also in my class. ___9___ books on the table are for our English lesson. Can you please give me ___10___ book? I also need ___11___ notebook. I like to study. ___12___ is my favorite hobby. What is your favorite hobby? Is ___13___ one of these? I see you have ___14___ new pencils. I also have ___15___ new pens.

explanation.en: The correct demonstrative depends on the noun's number and implied distance. 'This' and 'these' are for near items, 'that' and 'those' for far items. 'It' and 'he' are pronouns used in place of nouns.
explanation.ru: Правильное указательное местоимение зависит от числа существительного и подразумеваемого расстояния. 'This' и 'these' используются для близких предметов, 'that' и 'those' — для далеких. 'It' и 'he' — это местоимения, используемые вместо существительных.
explanation.uz: To'g'ri ko'rsatuvchi so'z otning soniga va taxminiy masofaga bog'liq. 'This' va 'these' yaqin narsalar uchun, 'that' va 'those' esa uzoq narsalar uchun ishlatiladi. 'It' va 'he' otlar o'rniga ishlatiladigan olmoshlardir.
